data.description:
Add evaluation fixtures for T15 so applicability and false-positive behavior are pinned before/at ship, and so the conjunctive S1-S3 gate is tuned on borderline cases.

## Work
- Add POSITIVE fixtures: a plan standing up a new deployed service that names its risky mechanisms (boot/auth/permission/connectivity/readiness) and commits to a fast out-of-loop proof -> T15 applies and passes; a similar plan that offers no faster feedback than the full loop -> T15 applies and reports finding(s).
- Add NEGATIVE (not-applicable) fixtures to docs/experiments/plan-review-gate/eval/observed-false-positives.md and the eval set: app-only/library/CLI plans, docs-only plans, and a plan that merely mentions a health route or "deploy" in app code -> PASS not-applicable.
- Add BORDERLINE fixtures probing S2 (a fast/cheap pipeline -> not-applicable) and S3 (a change whose correctness IS settled by unit tests -> not-applicable), since the S1-S3 conjunction is the main FP surface.
- Include a fixture proving check (d): a cleanup step that drops a pre-existing table/wipes a shared bucket to "reset" -> reports the scoped-cleanup finding.

## Acceptance criteria
- Fixtures run in the plan-review eval harness (docs/experiments/plan-review-gate/harnesses/harness.py) with the expected applies/not-applicable and finding outcomes.
- observed-false-positives.md lists the app-only negatives as regression guards.
data.title: Add T15 eval fixtures (positive + app-only/borderline negatives + scoped-cleanup)
